summary: Implemented the feature in the repository without committing. New modules: monai/data/csv_saver.py (CSVSaver) and monai/data/nifti_saver.py (NiftiSaver). Added plot_2d_or_3d_image to monai/visualize/img2tensorboard.py. Changed NIfTI writer default dtype to np.float32. Rewrote the segmentation and classification saver handlers as thin adapters, added the index parameter to TensorBoardImageHandler, and updated the sliding-window integration test and two unet_evaluation examples to use output_dir. Added tests test_csv_saver.py, test_nifti_saver.py, test_handler_segmentation_saver.py, and test_plot_2d_or_3d_image.py, and updated test_handler_classification_saver.py to pass filename. I could not run the tests or flake8, since I was told not to run repository code. I checked line length, trailing whitespace, file endings, and continuation alignment by reading and grep, and found no problems. Choices beyond the spec: per-item meta extraction skips None values, tensor affines are converted to numpy, the TensorBoard handler calls batch_transform once per iteration, and the segmentation example now keeps integer outputs as integers because the default dtype changed. The plot tests' event-file tag checks read raw bytes and may need a proper event parser if they prove flaky.
